Definition: , including the feminine ἡ, and the neuter τό in all their inflections; the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom):--the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.
BiblicalUsage: The word ho is the — a small word, used 6951 times; Matthew and Mark show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ho needs no more than its plain sense — the.
